summary.text: Planning the message structure and speaker turns to reflect the pizza location change from Rosa's to Mario's on Pine Street for Friday at noon with three participants.
Drafting speaker turns and pacing while keeping commitments implicit and avoiding full recital of time, place, and participants.
Assigning distinct speaker labels and enforcing natural pronouns while structuring a 36-line three-person exchange with implicit confirmation of unchanged details.

content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Maya: ugh bad news guys
Me: what now
Maya: just looked up Rosa's on Oak, they're closed Friday
Maya: like sign on the door says renovations all week
Leo: nooo seriously?
Me: damn, after all that knot talk too
Maya: i know, i was already dreaming about the parmesan ones
Leo: classic
Maya: what if we just do Mario's on Pine Street instead?
Me: oh for Friday? yeah that works for me
Leo: yeah that works, i'm still in
Maya: yay okay, thank god, i need pizza after this week
Leo: same, my laptop already froze once this morning
Me: already? it's like barely 9
Leo: did the restart thing, didn't help
Maya: ghosted by IT forever
Me: mine was dragging in standup too
Maya: are you guys freezing btw
Leo: yes fall jacket to my desk again
Me: same, wore the heavy one and i'm still cold
Maya: inside is freezing too, i need tea after coffee
Leo: ooo get me the weird lemon one virtually
Me: chamomile for me please
Maya: one weird one for leo, chamomile for you, got it
Leo: she remembers
Me: so noon still good for everyone?
Maya: yep!
Leo: yep, i can do noon
Maya: perfect, so just us three still?
Me: yep, i'm in
Leo: yeah all three, no change there
Maya: okay good, meet out front like usual?
Leo: bet, i'll text when i'm close
Me: i can walk over, like 10 mins
Maya: i'll bus over, it's easy
Leo: parking's kinda annoying over there but i'll circle
Me: lol remember last time
Leo: don't remind me
Maya: my legs are still dead from yesterday btw
Me: leg day again?
Maya: yeah morning gym was a mistake
Leo: never go back to leg day
Me: hahaha still stuck in my head",
  "writer_note": "Maya delivers the closure news and proposes Mario's on Pine Street as the Friday swap, with short acceptances from Me and Leo to keep noon and the trio intact without recapping. Morning office chatter, tea orders, and leg-day jokes carry their established voices and time window."
}
